required_stages.description: Allocate the (rows,) fp32 LOSS inside run().
Per row: fp32 term y*(guarded_log(y) - log_p) accumulated over all columns, one scalar written per row.

forbidden_substitutions.message: library KL divergence computes the operator
torch.xlogy computes the elementwise term in PyTorch
PyTorch log or row reduction on the data path
PyTorch select on the data path (guard must be in the kernel)

outputs.aliasing: none: fresh (rows,) fp32 tensor allocated inside run()

timing_boundary.notes: Measured: GPU time of all device work run() causes (the row map-reduce kernel(s), including any device fill of split-row scratch); shape reads and the LOSS allocation call are host work, not GPU time. No casts, copies or cross-call caches.
